cases.prompt: Use the installed plan-status skill to show this fixture's open and archived plan progress.
Show which local plans are in flight and which are ready to archive, plus the archived plan count and progress.
What is 2 + 2? Reply with only the number.

acceptance: Resolve installed identity and path from actual skills/list; never use the source skill path.
Use a fresh isolated thread for each case with only the fixture as the read-only project.
For direct input attach {type: skill, name, path} from installed discovery.
For indirect input do not attach or mention a skill; record model-requested reads of the installed SKILL.md.
Record output, commands, read paths and unchanged fixture hashes. Correct arithmetic alone is insufficient evidence of skill activation.
No mutation commands or MCP tools; no credentials copied to the disposable profile.
Mocked Responses cannot pass these semantic checks.
